### Greetings From Paul’s Associates
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/greetings-pauls-associates
Passage: Romans 16:21-24
Points:
- Paul concludes his letter by relaying greetings from his ministry associates to the believers in Rome.
- Tertius served as Paul's amanuensis, transcribing the letter and adding his own personal greeting in the Lord.
- The companions represented diverse roles and backgrounds, including Jewish delegates, Gaius who provided hospitality, and Erastus the city treasurer.
- Even the apostles depended deeply on loyal partners and helpers to carry out their ministry.
- God designed Christians for mutual support, showing that no believer is meant to minister or live alone.
